item: Every row since v0.5.0 names its PR and none still reads draft
summary: The release notes quote date, status and refs verbatim. Five rows since v0.5.0 got their PR numbers (#1754 #2009 #2018 #2019 #1980, each from the first-parent merge that added it), 27 merged rows that still said draft now say shipped, and 8 undated shipped.csv rows got the date of the commit that first recorded them. ledger_shipped check now refuses an undated row anywhere and, from 2026-11-02, a row with no PR number or a draft status.
